children.label: a
children.prompt: The area of the region between the two circular arcs.

answer.worked:
The shaded area is the outer sector area minus the inner sector area.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=30\times\frac{\pi}{180}\\\theta&=\frac{\pi}{6}\\A&=\frac{1}{2}(15^2-12^2)\times\frac{\pi}{6}\\A&=\frac{81\pi}{12}\\A&=\frac{27\pi}{4}\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: The perimeter of this shaded region.

answer.worked:
The boundary consists of both arcs and two straight segments, each of length $15-12=3\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=30\times\frac{\pi}{180}\\\theta&=\frac{\pi}{6}\\P&=12\times\frac{\pi}{6}+15\times\frac{\pi}{6}+2(15-12)\\P&=2\pi+\frac{5\pi}{2}+6\\P&=\left(\frac{9\pi}{2}+6\right)\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
